cases.name: Dominique Bibbins
cases.about: Her website https://dnicoleco.com/ introduction said, "Hey y'all! My name is Dominique and I love all things "Domestic". I know it sounds so old fashioned but it's really not! I enjoy Cooking, Baking, Sewing, Crafting, Decorating and so much more! I am also a Science + Tech Geek...How does that work? I'm not sure but it just does. lol. I am so many things, but most importantly, I am a lover. A lover of people, animals, nature and life. A free spirit that cannot be contained. My hope is to help you create a life that you love and look forward to every single day."
